classes.name: Tank
classes.identity: Stacks HP and resistances, starts fights with hard crowd control, and soaks damage for the team.
weaknesses: Melted by %HP, true damage and penetration

classes.name: Bruiser
classes.identity: Fighters and juggernauts: a mix of damage and durability, often with healing, built to win long fights and duels.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.identity: Mobile burst dealers who dash onto one squishy target, delete it, and get out.
strengths: High mobility for flanks and picks

classes.name: Mage
classes.identity: Ability damage from range: poke, burst and area damage with crowd control, gated by cooldowns.
weaknesses: Weak while key spells are on cooldown

classes.name: Marksman
classes.identity: Sustained auto-attack damage from range that scales with items into the biggest late-game threat.
weaknesses: Needs a front line and peel

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.identity: Supports who shield, heal and buff allies, and use slows and CC to peel divers off their carry.

matchups.why: Neither tank has the damage to kill the other quickly, so these fights are about who lands their engage on the enemy backline first.
matchups.tip: Don't spend your CC on their tank. Walk past it to their carries, and save a stun for their engage.

matchups.why: Bruisers bring sustained and %HP damage, so the longer the fight the more of your HP they chew through. Your CC stops them for a moment, but you can't kill them.
matchups.tip: Peel them off your carry with CC and let your damage dealers kill them. Build armor, with anti-heal if they heal.

matchups.why: Assassins are built to delete squishy targets in one combo. Your HP and resistances survive it, and your CC catches them before they can dash out.
matchups.tip: Stay near your carry and CC the assassin the moment they dash in.

matchups.why: Mages poke you from range and can kite your engage, but stacking magic resist blunts their burst, and once you land engage they die.
matchups.tip: Buy magic resist early, then engage when their key CC or escape is on cooldown.

matchups.why: Marksmen deal sustained damage with %HP and armor-penetration items that melt tanks, and they kite you from range while doing it.
matchups.tip: Don't stand in their range for free. Flank or engage straight onto them, and build armor.

matchups.why: Enchanters can't hurt you, but their shields, heals and peel undo your engage on their carry.
matchups.tip: Engage on the enchanter first, or wait for their peel spell before diving the carry.

matchups.why: Your sustained damage, healing and %HP items grind through a tank's health, while the tank's low damage can't kill you back.
matchups.tip: Take long fights. Build %HP or armor-penetration damage and stay on them through their CC.

matchups.why: Two duelists trading blows: whoever uses their cooldowns better, or has the item lead, wins.
matchups.tip: Track their heal or key cooldown and fight while it's down. Anti-heal decides close fights.

matchups.why: Assassins are built to burst squishies. Your HP and healing survive their combo, and you win the fight that follows.
matchups.tip: Let them spend their combo, then turn on them. They have nowhere to go once their dashes are used.

matchups.why: Mages slow, stun and poke you while you walk up to them, and burst you before you arrive.
matchups.tip: Wait for their CC to be used, then go in. Flank from fog instead of walking through their poke; magic resist and Quicksilver Enchant help.

matchups.why: Divers with dashes reach and kill marksmen, but juggernauts without dashes get kited. It comes down to your gap closer against their escape and peel.
matchups.tip: Dive only with your dash up and their escape down. Without a dash, flank instead of walking straight at them.

matchups.why: Enchanters are squishy but their shields, heals and slows blunt your dive onto their carry.
matchups.tip: Bait their peel spell first, then commit. Anti-heal cuts their healing.

matchups.why: Tanks are built to survive burst. Your full combo barely dents them, and their CC catches you on the way out.
matchups.tip: Ignore the tank. Flank around it to reach their carries.

matchups.why: Bruisers have the HP to survive your combo and the damage to kill you right after it.
matchups.tip: Don't commit onto bruisers. Look for squishy targets or clean-up kills instead.

matchups.why: Both sides one-shot squishies, so whoever finds their target first, or lands their combo first, wins.
matchups.tip: Ward the flanks and track where they are. Keep an escape ready while they're still alive.

matchups.why: Mages are squishy and rely on cooldowns. Get on them after their key spell is used and they can't escape your combo.
matchups.tip: Wait for their CC or escape to be used, then commit your full combo.

matchups.why: Marksmen are the squishiest targets and the biggest late-game threat. One combo removes them from the fight.
matchups.tip: Flank from fog and go in once their escape and Flash are down.

matchups.why: Enchanters exist to stop you: shields soak your burst, and their slows, knock-ups and CC stop the follow-up so your target survives.
matchups.tip: Catch the enchanter alone first, or bait out their peel before diving the carry.

matchups.why: Tanks shrug off your burst, but you can poke and kite them from range. Once they land engage on you, you're in trouble.
matchups.tip: Keep your distance and hold your CC for their engage. %HP magic damage helps.

matchups.why: Bruisers have to walk up to you. Your range, slows and CC kill or stop them before they arrive.
matchups.tip: Save your CC for their dash or engage, then walk backward while you damage them.

matchups.why: Assassins dash onto you and burst you before your spells come back up, and you have few ways to escape.
matchups.tip: Stand behind your team, hold your CC for their dash, and buy Stasis Enchant.

matchups.why: Range and cooldowns decide it: the mage who lands their key skill shot first usually wins the trade.
matchups.tip: Dodge their main skill shot, then trade during its cooldown.

matchups.why: You out-burst marksmen early, but they out-damage you late once their items let them auto you down.
matchups.tip: Punish them while they're weak early. Later, poke from range instead of standing in their attack range.

matchups.why: Enchanter shields absorb your burst, but steady poke wears through their heals and mana.
matchups.tip: Poke to drain their shields and heals before you commit your burst.

matchups.why: Sustained auto damage with %HP and armor-penetration items melts tanks, and they can't reach you if you kite.
matchups.tip: Hit the closest threat, kite backward, and build armor penetration or %HP damage.

matchups.why: You kite juggernauts with no dash all day, but mobile divers reach you and win the fight once they land.
matchups.tip: Hold your escape for their dash and keep your front line between you and them.

matchups.why: You're the assassin's favourite target: squishy, slow to escape, and dead to one full combo.
matchups.tip: Stand behind your team, ward your flanks, buy Stasis Enchant, and hold Flash for their dive.

matchups.why: Mages burst you from range early, but you out-damage them late once your items are online and their cooldowns can't keep up.
matchups.tip: Stay out of their CC range and farm safely until your items come online.

matchups.why: An even trade of autos from the same range: items, positioning and which support plays better decide who wins.
matchups.tip: Trade when their support is out of position or their escape is down.

matchups.why: Their shields and heals cut your damage, but sustained autos break shields faster than burst does.
matchups.tip: Hit the closest target and buy anti-heal against heavy healing.

matchups.why: You can't kill tanks, but they can't do much to you either. Their engage onto your carry is the real threat.
matchups.tip: Save your peel and shields for their engage on your carry.

matchups.why: Your shields and slows stop a bruiser's dive, but anti-heal cuts your heals and you're squishy if they turn on you.
matchups.tip: Peel the dive with slows and CC, and don't stand in front of your team.

matchups.why: Your shields absorb their burst and your CC stops their follow-up, so the target they dove survives.
matchups.tip: Stick to your carry and save your shield or CC for the assassin's dive.

matchups.why: Mage poke can wear you down in lane, but your shields absorb their burst in fights.
matchups.tip: Shield whoever they poke and stay out of their CC range.

matchups.why: Sustained auto damage breaks your shields over time, but your peel keeps your own carry alive.
matchups.tip: Peel for your carry and don't stand in their attack range.

matchups.why: Neither side has much damage of its own, so the lane and the fights are decided by the carries you're each protecting.
matchups.tip: Out-sustain them in lane and save your shields for real threats.
